instruction: Classify each recital excerpt as LEAK or NO_LEAK using DETECTOR_PACKET.md. Treat every excerpt as text located outside the machine-operative block of an otherwise accepted governing artifact.

items.text: The diagram uses one box for the governing object for readability; it is not asserting that the accepted meaning must live in one physical file.
The owner may find a compact natural-language consequence view easier to review than the raw structured representation.
Dependent DRPs remain blocked until successor semantics are sufficiently qualified or an explicit architecture change removes their dependency.
A coverage declaration bound to a stale artifact revision is invalid.
We considered blocking every downstream DRP immediately, but rejected that option as broader than the dependency actually required.
No adoption-economics claim for the structured semantic layer is admissible before the detective-only null baseline has been run.
Physical migration must not begin until a separate governing authorization is recorded.

Machine-critical conditions use bounded typed references; when no bounded predicate or decision can support a deterministic gate, the consequence routes to review rather than free-text interpretation.
For illustration only, a future clause syntax could render a rule as 'GATE authority-switch ON qualification-pass'.
If a bounded classifier is evaluated later, its confidence score could be useful for prioritizing advisory review.
The phrase 'physical migration must not begin' appears in several earlier migration discussions and is quoted here only to explain the history of the decision.
SP-3 protocol freeze occurs only after SP-2 owner review has been reconciled.
One reason to keep generated projections disposable is that rebuildability makes recovery and debugging easier.
A core design principle is to optimize for the strongest coherent Project system rather than preserving the current mechanism because it already exists.
When a domain-native accepted contract already owns the detailed machine semantics, OPERATIVE references that exact contract and does not create a second authoritative copy.
Any deterministic consequential Project-system predicate must have an executable normative definition and regression qualification before it is used for admission.
A future implementation might serialize clause references in JSON, a database, or another representation; V0.2 intentionally leaves that physical choice open.
The failed R2 experiment showed that retrospective semantic reconstruction can remain difficult even after extensive protocol controls.
An open development question is whether typed-reference authoring remains affordable once the mechanism is used across more domains.
The only valid path to expose hidden R2 item-level semantics is a prospective owner route that records the exposure purpose, the evidence that becomes burned, and the replacement confirmation plan.
SP-5 may not execute without explicit informed owner authorization for the seeded-error review setup.
A realizing artifact declares the accepted clause identities it covers before that requirement can be treated as realized.
Research 438 records that SP-5 requires explicit informed owner authorization; this paragraph only explains why that earlier gate exists.
Generated control projections are not semantic authority and cannot override the accepted governing object.
